title: Koi-Pak Okonomiyaki with Japanese Twist
description: A fusion twist on the classic Japanese street food, incorporating unique flavors and ingredients. Enjoy the delicate balance of sweet and savory.
instructions: Heat the Quietly Pan over medium heat.
In a bowl, whisk together Japanese Mayo, Soy Sauce, and Sesame Oil.
Add the beaten Velvety Eggs to the bowl and mix well.
Add the Okonomiyaki Mix, Koi Sauce, and a pinch of salt to the bowl and mix until combined.
Add the cut Pak Choy and Baby Corn to the bowl and mix well.
Pour the egg mixture into the Quietly Pan and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the Okonomiyaki and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes or until the other side is golden brown.
Optional: Top with additional Koi Sauce, sliced green onions, and a sprinkle of sesame seeds.
